summary.text: Andrew Brenner is a member of the Ohio Senate, representing District 19, which covers Delaware, Knox, Coshocton and Holmes counties. The Ohio Senate's biography says he is serving his second term in the Senate after four terms in the Ohio House of Representatives from 2011 to 2018.

paragraphs.text: The Senate's biography says Brenner graduated from The Ohio State University in 1993 with a bachelor of science in business administration, majoring in marketing and economics, and then spent 11 years as an entrepreneur in real estate and mortgage fields.
It says he recently earned a master of education in teaching and learning with an emphasis in leadership from Liberty University and is a licensed Realtor at AXEN Realty.

Before the Ohio House, Brenner served as Delaware County Recorder from 2005 to 2010, according to the biography, and earlier served on the Kingston Township zoning board and represented Kingston Township on the Delaware County Regional Planning Commission.

The biography says he belongs to the Delaware County Farm Bureau, the National Rifle Association and the Sunbury-Galena Rotary Club, and serves on the Delaware County Republican Party Central Committee.
It says he and his wife, Sara Marie, live in Delaware.
